body:
## Pull request overview

This PR consolidates multiple scattered roadmap documents into a single, shorter `ROADMAP.md` focused on remaining work toward Airtable-level UX parity, and removes the now-redundant satellite roadmap files.

**Changes:**
- Consolidated roadmap content into a single prioritized `ROADMAP.md` (P0–P3).
- Removed/deleted the separate spec, console, and designer roadmap documents.
- Updated roadmap framing to emphasize Airtable UX parity and current top priorities.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Rewrites and reprioritizes the roadmap into a single focused document (P0–P3), updates metrics/links. |
| ROADMAP_SPEC.md | Deleted (content no longer maintained separately). |
| ROADMAP_DESIGNER.md | Deleted (content absorbed/removed in favor of consolidated roadmap). |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Deleted (content absorbed/removed in favor of consolidated roadmap). |

The link target here uses `plugin-development.mdx`, but the docs directory contains `content/docs/guide/plugin-development.md` (no .mdx). This link will be broken unless the filename is corrected.
```suggestion
- [Plugin Development Guide](./content/docs/guide/plugin-development.md)
```

This line references "ROADMAP_DESIGNER" as a source, but this PR deletes ROADMAP_DESIGNER.md. Consider updating this to reference a stable URL (issue/PR link) or removing the source note to avoid a dangling reference.
```suggestion
> These two designers are the core user workflow.
```

The roadmap lists the inline ViewConfigPanel work as remaining, but the console already has a fully implemented ViewConfigPanel (apps/console/src/components/ViewConfigPanel.tsx) with substantial test coverage (apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx). Since the PR goal is to remove completed items, this section should either be removed or rewritten to only capture truly missing ViewConfigPanel gaps.

Several items in this "Spec Compliance Gaps" list appear to already be implemented in the codebase (e.g., DataScopeManager in packages/core/src/data-scope/DataScopeManager.ts, custom validator registration in packages/core/src/validation/validation-engine.ts, and STDEV/VARIANCE/PERCENTILE/MEDIAN in packages/core/src/evaluator/FormulaFunctions.ts). To keep this roadmap focused on remaining work (per PR description), consider removing or updating these entries to reflect the current state.
